69600-a-christmas-greeting.title: Christmas Greeting
69600-a-christmas-greeting.creator: Marie Corelli
69600-a-christmas-greeting.description: A book by Marie Corelli. But then, my excellent friend, you must remember that all the world does not wag in your particular way! You may possibly have thought now and then, as a self-concentrated unit, that because you are not merry (and you never will be, I fear)--therefore no one else has any right to be so. This is your little mistake!

arxiv-2105-08695.title: Acoustic scattering reduction of elliptical targets via pentamode near-cloaking based on transformation acoustics in elliptic coordinates
arxiv-2105-08695.creator: Davide Enrico Quadrelli, Gabriele Cazzulani, Simone La Riviera, Francesco Braghin
arxiv-2105-08695.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Davide Enrico Quadrelli, Gabriele Cazzulani, Simone La Riviera, Francesco Braghin. Cloaks for underwater applications designed for actual submarine acoustic stealth are still far from the technological advancement needed for being put in practice. Several challenges are to be overcame such as dealing with weight or non-axisymmetric shapes.

arxiv-2208-06862.title: A note on the distribution of Iwasawa invariants of imaginary quadratic fields
arxiv-2208-06862.creator: Anwesh Ray
arxiv-2208-06862.description: Abstract . Given an odd prime number p p and an imaginary quadratic field K K , we establish a relationship between the p p -rank of the class group of K K , and the classical λ \lambda -invariant of the cyclotomic ℤ p \mathbb{Z}_{p} -extension of K K .

arxiv-2301-12517.title: Revealing a deep connection between factorization and saturation: New insight into modeling high-energy proton-proton and nucleus-nucleus scattering in the EPOS4 framework
arxiv-2301-12517.creator: K. Werner
arxiv-2301-12517.description: Abstract It is known that multiple partonic scatterings in high-energy proton-proton ( p ​ p pp ) collisions must happen in parallel. However, a rigorous parallel scattering formalism, taking energy sharing properly into account, fails to reproduce factorization, which on the other hand is the basis of almost all p ​ p pp event generators.

arxiv-2309-07191.title: Information Flow as an Emergent Property of Divergence in Phase-Space
arxiv-2309-07191.creator: Praveen Kumar
arxiv-2309-07191.description: Abstract Recent developments have created the ability to quantify information flow among components that interact in a dynamical system, and have led to significant advances in characterizing the dependence between the variables involved. In particular, they have been used to characterize causal dependency and feedback using observations across diverse fields such as environment, climate, finance, and human health.

arxiv-2405-06667.title: Sentiment Polarity Analysis of Bangla Food Reviews Using Machine and Deep Learning Algorithms
arxiv-2405-06667.creator: Al Amin 1 , Anik Sarkar 2 , Md Mahamodul Islam 3 , Asif Ahammad Miazee 4 , Md Robiul Islam 5 , Md Mahmudul Hoque 6
arxiv-2405-06667.description: Abstract The Internet has become an essential tool for people in the modern world. Humans, like all living organisms, have essential requirements for survival. These include access to atmospheric oxygen, potable water, protective shelter, and sustenance. The constant flux of the world is making our existence less complicated.

arxiv-2412-09741.title: On Round-Off Errors and Gaussian Blur in Superresolution and in Image Registration
arxiv-2412-09741.creator: Serap A. Savari
arxiv-2412-09741.description: Abstract Superresolution theory and techniques seek to recover signals from samples in the presence of blur and noise. Discrete image registration can be an approach to fuse information from different sets of samples of the same signal. Quantization errors in the spatial domain are inherent to digital images.

arxiv-2503-05311.title: Upper tail bounds for irregular graphs
arxiv-2503-05311.creator: Anirban Basak, Shaibal Karmakar
arxiv-2503-05311.description: Abstract . We consider the upper tail large deviations of subgraph counts for irregular graphs H in 𝔾 ⁡ ( n , p ) \mathbb{G}(n,p) , the sparse Erdős-Rényi graph on n n vertices with edge connectivity probability p ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) p\in(0,1) .

arxiv-2508-02704.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Seraj Al Mahmud Mostafa, Jianwu Wang. Satellite images present unique challenges due to their high object variability and lower spatial resolution, particularly for detecting atmospheric gravity waves which exhibit significant variability in scale, shape, and pattern extent, making accurate localization highly challenging.

europmc-pmc5028995.title: Recent advances in bioprinting techniques: approaches, applications and future prospects.
europmc-pmc5028995.creator: Li J, Chen M, Fan X, Zhou H.
europmc-pmc5028995.description: Bioprinting technology shows potential in tissue engineering for the fabrication of scaffolds, cells, tissues and organs reproducibly and with high accuracy. Bioprinting technologies are mainly divided into three categories, inkjet-based bioprinting, pressure-assisted...

pmc-10605311.title: “She gives it to her child who doesn’t even talk”: a qualitative exploration of alcohol and drug use among primary school-age children in Uganda
pmc-10605311.creator: Joyce Sserunjogi Nalugya, Vilde Skylstad, Juliet N Babirye, Andrew Sentoogo Ssemata, Grace Ndeezi, Paul Bangirana, Ingunn M S Engebretsen, Noeline Nakasujja
pmc-10605311.description: BackgroundThere is little research on alcohol and other drugs (AOD) use by school-age children in low-resource settings like Uganda. Including the voices of children in research can inform prevention and early intervention efforts for those at risk of AOD use.

pmc-11638822.title: Early enteral nutrition (EEN) following intestinal anastomosis in pediatric patients – what’s new?
pmc-11638822.creator: Sabine Drossard, Louisa Schuffert
pmc-11638822.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionAbdominal surgery in children may disrupt normal gut function, necessitating prolonged fasting, which can lead to complications such as dehydration and nutritional deficits. Early enteral nutrition (EEN) after surgical procedures can enhance wound healing, prevent malnutrition, and expedite recovery.

pmc-11685138.title: Pyridostigmine as a therapeutic option for pediatric gastrointestinal dysmotilities in ATR-X syndrome. Case report and literature review
pmc-11685138.creator: F. F. Comisi, C. Soddu, M. Corpino, M. Marica, R. Cacace, T. Foiadelli, S. Savasta
pmc-11685138.description: BackgroundAlpha-thalassemia X-linked intellectual disability (ATR-X) syndrome, is a rare genetic disorder, caused by mutations in the ATRX gene. Clinical manifestations include typical facial dysmorphisms, mild-to-severe intellectual disability, hypotonia, genital anomalies, significant gastrointestinal (GI) complications, such as abdominal distension, chronic constipation, feeding difficulties, gastroesophageal reflux, and mild-to-moderate anemia secondary to alpha-thalassemia.

pmc-12470319.title: Polydatin Modulates Inflammatory Cytokine Expression in Lipoteichoic Acid-Stimulated Human Dental-Pulp Stem Cells
pmc-12470319.creator: Rawan Al-Ateeq, Mona Elsafadi, Manikandan Muthurangan, Solaiman Al-Hadlaq
pmc-12470319.description: Gram-positive bacteria are responsible for initiating dental caries. In this process, lipoteichoic acid (LTA), which is expressed on Gram-positive bacteria cell walls, binds to the dental pulp cells, triggering an immune response, followed by inflammation and eventually pulp necrosis. Polydatin is a polyphenolic compound that has been shown to modulate inflammatory mediators in a manner favorable to healing.

pmc-12481962.title: Regulatory roles of GA and sugar metabolism genes with metabolomic profiling during seed dormancy release in Gleditsia sinensis
pmc-12481962.creator: Fuhua Liu, Yang Zhao, Xiurong Wang, Qingying Zeng, Xingfu Zhang, Biao Wang, Lang He, Xueyan Jian
pmc-12481962.description: BackgroundGleditsia sinensis is a significant economic and ecological tree species in Guizhou Province, offering high economic value and substantial development opportunities. Reproduction of G. sinensis primarily involves seed propagation, requiring a yearly supply of high-quality seeds for production. Nonetheless, seeds are characterised by a hard and dormant composition, and the precise molecular mechanism behind dormancy release remains unclear.

pmc-13191954.title: Multimorbidity and functioning disparities in retired older adults: longitudinal trajectories, disease clusters, and mediating mechanisms
pmc-13191954.creator: Nnaelue Godfrey Ojijieme, Long Xiao
pmc-13191954.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMultimorbidity is a major determinant of older adults’ functioning, yet its long-term pathways and underlying mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. Retired older adults face unique vulnerabilities due to declining occupational activity, reduced socioeconomic buffers, and increased dependence on functional capacity.

pmc-13199998.title: Comprehensive assessment of novel cardiovascular biomarkers in AF
pmc-13199998.creator: Amelie H Ohlrogge, Daniel Engler, Patricia Schlieker, Ferdinand Seum, Kim Rosebrock, Nicole Nebel, Dora Csengeri, Larissa Fabritz, André Ziegler, Stefan Blankenberg, Paulus Kirchhof, Tanja Zeller, Renate B Schnabel
pmc-13199998.description: AimsBiomarkers have the potential to improve risk prediction beyond clinical characteristics. We examined the association of four emerging cardiovascular biomarkers [angiopoietin 2 (Angpt2), bone morphogenetic protein 10 (BMP10), fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23), insulin-like growth factor binding protein 7 (IGFBP7)] in comparison with N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) across the disease course of atrial fibrillation (AF).

pmc-13392001.title: Evaluating urban oriental plane wood as a tonewood: effects of solvent extraction on acoustic performance
pmc-13392001.creator: Mehran Roohnia
pmc-13392001.description: This research investigates the acoustic potential of mature Oriental plane wood (Platanus orientalis L.) harvested from urban environments for use in musical instrument manufacturing. While traditionally undervalued as low grade raw material, this species offers unique aesthetic properties that could be enhanced for high value lutherie applications.

pmc-13486360.title: Complete mitochondrial genome characterization of the haemosporidian parasite Nycteria heischi in bats Megaderma spasma in Thailand
pmc-13486360.creator: Pattaranatcha Charnwichai, Juthathip Poofery, Dimas Novianto, Siwaporn Tuangpermsub, Thongchai Ngamprasertwong, Morakot Kaewthamasorn
pmc-13486360.description: Haemosporidian parasites are vector-borne protozoans that infect a wide range of vertebrate and invertebrate hosts. Among mammals, bats harbor species of at least seven recognized haemosporidian genera, including Plasmodium, Polychromophilus, and Nycteria, highlighting the remarkable diversity of these parasites in chiropteran hosts. Thailand is a major biodiversity hotspot, supporting more than 146 bat species and their associated pathogens.
